title: VAT tool by firm
description: What one firm's users and data are doing (NFR-14). Pick the firm at the top; All shows every firm together.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: API requests from this firm's users in the selected range.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Requests that failed on our side (HTTP 5xx). Anything above zero needs a look.

panels.title: Rows loaded
panels.description: Rows that reached the ledger from files, SFTP, connectors and the REST API.

panels.title: Rows rejected
panels.description: Rows refused at load. Each one is listed on the client's Data tab with its reason.

panels.title: Rows held
panels.description: Rows waiting for something, such as an exchange rate. They block approval until they load.

panels.title: Reconciliation failures
panels.description: Period refreshes that threw an error. The period stays queued and is retried.

panels.title: Requests per minute
panels.description: API requests from this firm's users.

panels.title: Errors per minute
panels.description: Refused requests (4xx, often a missing permission or a stale link) and failures on our side (5xx).

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: Average time to answer a request, and the slowest request in each moment.

panels.title: Rows loaded
panels.description: Rows in each bar's slice of time. Unchanged rows were already in the ledger, as when a file is sent again.

panels.title: Rows rejected or held
panels.description: Rows in each bar's slice of time that did not load. Rejected rows need fixing at source; held rows load once what they wait for arrives.

panels.title: E-invoice events
panels.description: Events from the e-invoicing platform in each bar's slice of time. A duplicate was already applied and changed nothing.

panels.title: Data load time
panels.description: Average time for one data load, from the file arriving to the last row written, and the slowest load.

panels.title: Data loads by file kind
panels.description: Loads in the selected range, by template.

panels.title: Reconciliations
panels.description: Return recomputes and reconciliation runs in each bar's slice of time, whatever started them.

panels.title: Reconciliation time
panels.description: Average time for one recompute and reconciliation of a period, and the slowest.

panels.title: Reconciliation failures
panels.description: Background refreshes that failed, in each bar's slice of time. The period stays queued and is retried.

panels.title: Reconciliations by trigger
panels.description: Runs in the selected range, by what started them: a data change, a sign-off, an approval, a person.

panels.title: Deadline alerts sent
panels.description: People alerted about a return or payment deadline, in each bar's slice of time.

panels.title: Webhook deliveries
panels.description: Deliveries to this firm's webhooks in each bar's slice of time. A retry is tried again later; a failure has used all 8 attempts.

panels.title: Emails that failed to send
panels.description: Notification emails the mail server refused, in each bar's slice of time. The in-app notification still arrives.
